profile.headline: Software Developer at Edmunds GovTech || MS in Comp Sic from North Carolina State University
profile.summary:
Recent graduate with a Masters in Computer Science from North Carolina State University. In my previous role, I was a Application Development engineer at Denso working on data collection, data visualization, automation and network administration. I have experience in diverse areas such as web development, IoT, and cloud development.

Open to full time opportunities and internships/co-ops for software engineering and cloud engineering roles. 

GitHub: https://github.com/rpate136

Programming languages I have experience in: 
Python, Java, SQL, JavaScript, HTML

List of tools and frameworks I have used:
Amazon Web Services (AWS), Ansible, Docker, Django, FastAPI, Git, GraphQL, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Linux, Microsoft SQL Server, Spring Boot, NodeJS, NextJS, NumPy, pandas, PostgreSQL, Postman, React, RestAPI, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing a web application for local government for finance and accounting. 

Technology Stack: Java Spring, Angular, MySQL, AWS

positions.title: Application Development Engineer (IoT)
positions.description:
• Maintained the infrastructure of network and hardware for collecting real time data from 20 automated assembly lines.
• Reduced time spent on data analysis by 80% by creating meaningful dashboards and automated report generation.
• Optimized report availability to a one-day lag by crafting scripts for migrating data from SQL servers and excel sheets and developed ETL pipelines for data processing.
• Utilized VMware to provision and manage Linux servers and ensured security, efficiency, and observability.
• Facilitated cross-functional meetings with QA, engineering, and maintenance teams to elicit and refine project requirements as well as ensure understanding across departments.
positions.insights: Technical Specs, Agile Software Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Heat Transfer (MEGR 3116)
positions.description:
• Arrange Supplemental Instruction sessions every week in which students get to experience how to approach and solve heat transfer questions and clarify any questions regarding the material
• Handle grading of homework assignments and test of 100+ students while giving constructive feedback on problems done wrong

projects.title: Art Store Webapp - Cloud Architect
projects.description:
• Designed a detailed document with a team of three people outlining the design of a cloud native application on AWS
• Examined the AWS Well Architected Framework to create technical requirements and evaluated important trade-offs
• Assembled a set of AWS services which can meet the technical requirements and made CloudFormation diagrams

projects.title: Robot Controlled Connect Four
projects.description:
• Collaborated in a team of six people to design and build an IoT and Robot controlled connect four game
• Programmed the game logic and the main communication client which controlled the game flow utilizing MQTT protocol 
• Prepared a final report and a final presentation to showcase the system working and its future applications

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.position: Vice President and Treasurer · Sep 2016 - May 2020
organizations.description: Society Of Hispanic Professional  Engineers is a very renounced club throughout the US. Their main goal is to spread STEM awareness within the community, particularly within the hispanic community. As part of SHPE, I have organized various workshops and presentations ranging from academic development, leadership development, to community outreach. I have also organized 'noche de ciencias', or Night of Science, in order to spread STEM awareness to kids from elementary, middle, and high school and to also inform Hispanic parents about the college application process. Being part of this club has taught me a lot about leadership, professionalism, and countless other soft skills, which have helped me grow professionally and personally.

organizations.name: UNC FIRST Robotics
organizations.position: Member in Mechanical Team · Sep 2014 - Apr 2015
organizations.description: FIRST robotics competition is the biggest robotics competition for high school students. Each year there are new fun and challenges. Students are guided by mentors and experts within the engineering field in order to meet the requirements for the competition.
